data.description:
harvest-worktree.sh (lines 228-240) requires review-status to exist in the worktree artifacts dir. In dso.workflow=ci-pr mode, commit-emit-skip-markers.sh creates reviewer-record.skipped but NOT review-status. Result: harvest always exits 2 in ci-pr sprints unless all changed files are allowlisted.

Steps to reproduce:
1. Set dso.workflow=ci-pr
2. Create a sprint with .sprint-active
3. Dispatch a sub-agent in an isolated worktree
4. Sub-agent commits changes (commit-emit-skip-markers.sh creates reviewer-record.skipped, not review-status)
5. Run harvest-worktree.sh → exits 2 with 'ERROR: review-status not found'

Expected: harvest-worktree.sh should check for reviewer-record.skipped with reason=dso.workflow=ci-pr and treat it as an intentional ci-pr deferred review (equivalent to _skip_review=true path).

Proposed fix: In harvest-worktree.sh after the skip-review-check block, add: if reviewer-record.skipped exists with 'dso.workflow=ci-pr' reason, set _skip_review=true.

Related: commit-emit-skip-markers.sh creates reviewer-record.skipped but harvest-worktree.sh ignores it.
data.title: harvest-worktree.sh fails in ci-pr mode: review-status never created but always required
